rationale: Both independently caught the two strongest latent issues — the 'Attention optimization' heading in design/index.md swallowing four unrelated design docs (echoing GT's 'do we have other attention backend?'), and GGUF being silently dropped from .nav.yml while still advertised in two user-facing tables — with strong code-grounded verification (tests, pipeline files, config defaults). Y edges ahead by also surfacing the BitsAndBytes add/remove git history within the same PR (touching GT's BitsAndBytes concern, even if resolved by diff time) and by presenting more findings with consistent explicit 'Change:' actionable directives; X's findings are equally well-grounded but narrower. Neither candidate addressed GT's diffusion_features.md:228 quantization-alignment note or features/README.md's 'does it belong to diffusion only?' scoping question.
